thread:
Alex: Heads-up — planning to deploy the new quantized gpt-small-ml model to staging at 09:30 PT. Will also roll out dashboard panels for model-level token latency and KV cache hit rate.
Priya: I can own the deploy if Sam is on call? will run smoke checks and keep an eye on traces.
Sam: Yep I’m on call that window. Ping me in this thread when you start the canary.
Tomas: Quick ask — what alert thresholds are we changing? We want to avoid noisy alerts for GPU worker 7.
Alex: Good call. Plan is to bump the per-worker token-latency alert from 300ms -> 450ms for the next 24h for this rollout, and add a temporary suppression for worker 7. Will document in the incident-runbook section.
Priya: Added a new panel in the staging ML dashboard: `ml/model/gpt-small-ml/latency_p50_p95` and `ml/model/gpt-small-ml/kv_cache_hit`. Dashboards link: https://console.redwood/staging/d/ML_OBS/gpt-small-ml
Maya: Can you paste the smoke checklist here? I want to run an independent pass.
Priya: Sure — quick checklist:
```
- deploy canary to 3 replicas in staging
- run 10x small-gen (seq=64) and 10x long-gen (seq=1024)
- verify p95 latency < 450ms for small-gen, < 1200ms for long-gen
- verify KV cache hit rate >= 65% across canary requests
- confirm no new errors in model-serving logs
- check traces for any backend stalls (>200ms blocking DB calls)
```
Sam: I’ll run the trace sweep: `traces.query("service:ml-serving AND span.duration>200ms")` and filter by `gpt-small-ml` after canary starts.
Tomas: For alerts, I’ll add a temporary rule: `suppress_alert("gpu-worker-7", duration=24h, reason="canary-run")`. Also will raise the global latency threshold as Alex suggested.
Alex: Deploy-bot: start canary for `gpt-small-ml` -> 3 replicas in staging at 1717890180
deploy-bot: Canary started (id: canary-7801), watch at https://console.redwood/staging/canaries/canary-7801 :thumbsup:
Priya: Canary up. Running smoke scripts now. I’ll paste results in a sec.
Priya: Smoke results: small-gen p95=420ms, small-gen p50=110ms, long-gen p95=980ms, KV hit=68%, 0 model-serving 5xx. Traces show one 320ms DB call but isolated to a batch op.
Maya: Looks good to me. I did an independent small-gen run and saw similar latency.
Sam: Trace sweep done — found that batch op spans at 320ms within `embedding-builder` during one request; not widespread. Tagging `PR-1452` as follow-up to investigate batching threshold.
Tomas: Alert changes applied and suppression active for gpu-worker-7. I’ve scheduled auto-rollback window 09:55 PT if p95 > 800ms or >0.5% error rate.
Alex: TL;DR — canary healthy, dashboards updated, alerts temporarily relaxed, rollback guard in place. We’ll promote to full staging traffic at 09:40 PT unless anyone objects.
Maya: No objections. good to promote.
Sam: Go for promoting at 09:40. I’ll keep monitoring for the next 30m.
Priya: Promoting to full staging now. deploy-bot: promote canary canary-7801 -> staging (full).
deploy-bot: Promotion started, rollout percent=100%
Priya: Post-promote quick checks: p95 small-gen=435ms, KV hit=66%, no new 5xx.
Alex: Nice. Will keep this thread as the audit note and create follow-up task for PR-1452 for the batch op. Thanks everyone :rocket:
